$comment: Canonical agent catalog. Edit this file or prompts/*.md, then run `python3 scripts/render.py`. Provider files are generated.

agents.description: Main-thread Fable technical lead: clarifies outcomes, delegates bounded work, integrates and verifies. Primary agent only; never dispatch it as a worker.

Engineering editor for substantial rewrites, delicate workplace wording, long documents, or an explicit Alan Wake request. Returns one finished draft with links for the actual output surface; never sends or publishes.

Read-only repository explorer for one bounded question: file and symbol discovery, behavior and dependency tracing, architecture, tests, or implementation context. Supports quick, medium, and very thorough depth. Never edits.
Read-only task shaper for vague, symptom-based, conflicting, risky, or solution-first requests. Establishes evidence, scope, acceptance criteria, and the one decision needed before work. Never edits.

Reviews and repairs a completed GitLab MR before, after, or between human reviews: audits the full diff for defects, regressions, security, performance, tests, and hygiene; validates open discussions; applies focused fixes; prepares replies. Not for feature development, approval, assignment, or merge.
Independent read-only review of a completed high-risk or unfamiliar change when existing review evidence is insufficient. Returns actionable findings and coverage gaps; never fixes or publishes.
